title: Mountain Creek Family Resort

services.name: Day Pass
services.desc: Have a day of fun and relaxation at our campground. You can access our grounds for the day and enjoy our amenities and river access. services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: We have 20 Cabins (Cabins A-T) with electric & water. They have 3 full and 3 twin beds, a sitting/dining area, microwave, and small refrigerator. **Cabins A & B have 2 queen bunk beds.**They also have a picnic table and fire pit. There is air conditioning and electricity, with outside water access.Guests have access

services.name: Cottage Rentals
services.desc: Our small cottage or previously known as Cabin C has 2 queen beds, a sleeper sofa, and outside sitting area. There is air conditioning, a microwave, and a small refrigerator. services.name: 6-Person Raft Rentals
services.desc: You can float down the scenic river with your friends or family, and enjoy the sights and sounds of nature. You’ll have the opportunity to stop at sandbars, swim, fish, or picnic along the way. Our rafts are sturdy, comfortable, and easy to relax in. We’ll provide you with life jackets, paddles, and a shuttle service

services.name: Canoe Rentals
services.desc: If you’re looking for a more adventurous way to experience the Niangua river, our canoe rentals are a great option for you. You can paddle down the beautiful river with your partner or friend, and enjoy the thrill of navigating the rapids and curves. We’ll provide you with life jackets, paddles, and a shuttle service

services.name: Water Slide
services.desc: If you’re looking for a splash of fun and excitement at our campground, our giant slip and slide waterslide is a must-try for you. Slide down our long waterslide and feel the rush of speed and water. You can also enjoy the view of the river and the woods as you slide. Our waterslide is safe and fun for all ages.
